content.title: What is Feature Engineering?
content.explanation:
• Transforming raw, messy data.
• Creating mathematical signals.
• Helps algorithms learn easily.
• Better features beat better algorithms.
• Example: Extracting 'Age' from 'DOB'.

content.title: Data Cleaning Workflow
content.explanation:
• Clean before engineering.
• Fix missing values.
• Remove duplicates.
• Standardize formats.
• Prevents broken models.

content.title: Handling Missing Data: Imputation Strategies
content.explanation: Different strategies for handling missing data, from mean imputation to complex predictive models.

content.title: Feature Scaling
content.explanation:
• Puts numbers on similar scale.
• Prevents large numbers dominating.
• Crucial for distance algorithms.
• Scale features, not labels.
• Use MinMaxScaler or StandardScaler.

buckets.name: Standardization
accepts: Centers data at a mean of 0.

buckets.name: Robust Scaler
accepts: Uses IQR to ignore extreme outliers.

content.title: Min-Max vs Standardization
content.explanation:
• Min-Max: Bounds between 0 and 1.
• Min-Max: Sensitive to outliers.
• Standardization: Centers at mean 0.
• Standardization: Good for Gaussian data.
• Pick based on distribution.

content.title: Robust vs MaxAbs Scaler
content.explanation:
• Robust: Uses Median and IQR.
• Robust: Ignores extreme outliers.
• MaxAbs: Divides by absolute max.
• MaxAbs: Preserves zeros.
• Use Robust for billionaires' salaries.

content.title: Log vs Power Transform
content.explanation:
• Log: Compresses highly skewed data.
• Log: Only works on positive numbers.
• Power: Automatically finds best power.
• Power: Can handle negative numbers.
• Turns skews into bell curves.

content.title: Outlier Detection
content.explanation:
• Outliers pull models off track.
• Visualized with Boxplots.
• Can be typos or fraud.
• Use Z-Scores or IQR.
• Cap them or drop them.

content.title: Encoding Categorical Variables
content.explanation:
• One-Hot: Binary columns per category.
• One-Hot: Best for non-ordered (Colors).
• Target: Replaces with average target.
• Target: Best for Zip Codes.
• Avoid 10,000 column explosions.

content.title: Date & Time Features
content.explanation:
• Extract numerical features from dates.
• Month, Day, Hour, Is_Weekend.
• Time holds cyclical patterns.
• Converts calendars into habits.
• Watch out for timezones.

content.title: Text Data: TF-IDF
content.explanation:
• Bag of Words: Just counts.
• Dominates common words ('the').
• TF-IDF: Penalizes common words.
• Highlights rare, meaningful words.
• Baseline for NLP tasks.

content.title: Lesson Summary
content.explanation:
• Clean data first.
• Handle missing values.
• Scale features (except for trees).
• Encode text and categories.
• Great features beat great algorithms.
